title: ROS 2 interfaces (msg, srv, action)
keywords: interface interfaces msg srv action message type definition idl show
text: Messages (.msg), services (.srv) and actions (.action) are interfaces, generated for every client library. A publisher and a subscriber must use the same type name and the same definition: a changed definition on one host, for example from another package version, breaks communication even when the name matches. ros2 interface show pkg/msg/Type prints a definition and ros2 interface list shows what is installed. Rebuild and source the workspace on every machine after changing an interface.
